metadata_status: pitch_end/camera_angle/venue absent from source; human annotation required

clip_diversity.floor_is_not_a_target: 24 clips x 8 images is exactly 192, so collecting 24 clips means every clip sits at the cap -- the least diverse batch the policy permits. Prefer more clips at 4-6 frames each; scene count is the quantity that was actually missing, and frames within one clip are near-duplicates of each other by construction.
clip_diversity.new_clip_definition: a distinct broadcast of a distinct fixture. Another segment of a match already among the existing 18 clips does NOT count as new, and neither does a second camera cut of the same passage of play.
clip_diversity.rationale: 192 images capped at 8 per clip forces >=24 independent scenes. 8 is the observed per-clip yield for these framings in the current set (max 7 for index 5, 7 for index 29, 9 for mirror-stress), so it is a ceiling on what one broadcast plausibly supplies rather than an arbitrary cut. It bounds any one clip at 4.2% of the batch, against 24.3% for the worst existing clip (42ba34, 77 of 317).

buckets.name: near_corner_right_in_frame
buckets.acceptance: index 29 in >=90% of accepted frames; >=8 distinct clips
buckets.rationale: index 29 at 11/317 and those 11 come from only 4 clips, 7 of them from one -- the worst deficit in both image count and scene count; 64 frames lifts it to ~69

buckets.name: near_corner_left_in_frame
buckets.acceptance: index 5 in >=90% of accepted frames; >=6 distinct clips
buckets.rationale: index 5 at 27/317 across 10 clips; 48 frames lifts it to ~70

buckets.name: mirror_stress_wide_unseen_venue
buckets.requires: both ends in frame, fixture and venue outside the existing 18 clips
buckets.acceptance: >=50% carry one end-exclusive near-side anchor; >=6 distinct clips
buckets.rationale: wide both-ends framing has mean flip-symmetry 0.746, the highest of any framing, and 43 of 317 images already sit at >=0.75; this is where a mirrored fit is unpenalised. The existing 31 qualifying images cannot serve this bucket -- they are by definition the already-seen venues

buckets.name: venue_lighting_camera_diversity
buckets.requires: >=4 distinct venues, >=3 lighting conditions, camera height varied incl. some low
buckets.acceptance: no single venue >40% of the bucket; >=4 distinct clips
buckets.rationale: genuine generalisation cover; does not address the landmark deficit, so it is not given more

buckets_retired.name: end_asymmetric_alternating
buckets_retired.reason: 167 existing images already satisfy it (exactly one end in frame, flip-symmetry <=0.35), drawn from all 18 clips, against a target of 32. The model failed at mirroring despite that supply, so more of it was not the fix.
buckets_retired.action: curate and tag the existing 167 rather than collect; ensure train retains them across all available clips
